programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer äntligen iväg till Paris, men hennes drömresa blir nästan förstörd när hon upptäcker att Brody har hittat en ny. Spencer följer efter Heidi till Colorado, för att vinna tillbaka henne, men planen går i baklås.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney måste välja mellan tryggheten på Teen Vogue och riskerna med en ny karriär. Lauren och Brody hamnar i konflikt om hans nya flickvän och Heidi anpassar sig till ett liv utan Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en osannolik vän när Spenders syster Stephanie börjar på hennes modekurs. Whitney tycker att det nya jobbet är som en dröm, men en hektisk resa till New York får henne att minnas att man ska vara försiktig med vad man önskar sig.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi försöker vinna tillbaka Audrinas vänskap, men Lauren är misstänksam mot motiven bakom. Whitney anpassar sig till sitt nya jobb, men märker snabbt att hon saknar att jobba med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi älskar sitt singelliv ända tills hon ser Spencer med andra tjejer och blir svartsjuk. Whitney värvar Lauren för att hjälpa till på LA Fashion Week, och öppnar på så sätt nya dörrar för Lauren i hennes karriär.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute ur bilden gör Heidi ett sista forsök att återvinna Laurens vänskap. När Audrina börjar umgås mer med Heidi och Justin ifrågasätter Lauren om de ska fortsätta att bo ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: En gammal romans väcks upp när Stephen Colletti åter kommer in i Laurens liv. Heidi försöker hindra Stephanie från att gå på Laurens inflyttningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren kläms mellan vänner när det blir spänt mellan Lo och Audrina. Efter att ha beslutat att det är slut med Spencer accepterar Heidi ett jobberbjudande som kommer att ta henne till Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen känner Audrina sig utestängd av Laurens nära vänskap med Lo och funderar på att flytta ut. Lauren gör ett innerligt försök att bli sams med Audrina, men det kan vara för sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: När säsong fyra börjar är läget mellan Audrina och Lo spänt. Lauren försöker göra gott intryck på en ny kille, och ett besök från Heidis syster Holly hotar Spencers och Heidis förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir ovän med sin bror och vän när Lauren springer på Spencer på hennes födelsedag. Kelly Cutrone sparkar nån på People's Revolution och Whitney fyller luckan. Laurens förhållande med Doug kanske går lite för fort fram.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Battle of the Divas
programme.desc: Känslorna svallar när Victoria slits mellan Michael och en nyanländ. Lateysha får ett utbrott när Marissa flörtar med David, och Joey framför en romantisk rap för Lorena.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Heartbreak
programme.desc: Den mest dramatiska och känslosamma ankomsten ger Lorena hjärtesorg, men innebär det slutet för JOLO? Michael anförtror sig åt Ellie, men kan han glömma Victoria?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Joeys osäkerhet tar över när Lorena vill skapa ljuv musik med Patrick. David ber äntligen Lateysha om ursäkt, och det blir chockerande dubbel ankomst på stranden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Calum's Choice
programme.desc: Paddan tvingar Calum att skicka hem ett ex, Georgia blir känslosam med Ashley, Michael och Ellie blir nära "vänner", och en överraskningskändis lurar vid horisonten.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Miles and the Mob Wife
programme.desc: Den nya kändisen Miles gör starkt intryck på Marissa, David får dubbla reprimander, och tjejerna har ett tufft beslut framför sig.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: As One Door Closes Another One Opens
programme.desc: En kille skickas hem och tjejerna blir ledsna. Allt blir för mycket för en av de ursprungliga åtta. Sophie kan ha träffat sin drömkarl. Kommer David att få en andra chans?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling DXL
programme.desc: I ett rykande färskt Ridiculousness gör Rob, Chanel och Steelo kanonkulan ner i en pool i 'Pool ovan mark-galningar', presenterar 'Riktig fakta' och går till gymmet med sin 'Pre-workout'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Waka Flocka Flame
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' kommer rapparen Waka Flocka Flame till Rob, Steelo och Chanel för att anlita 'Kvalificerade rullare', förbluffas av folk som klarar det 'Utan händer' och skratta åt 'Skitskämtarna'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Steve-O
programme.desc: I ett rykande färskt "Ridiculousness" gästar legendaren från "Jackass": Steve­-O. Han, Rob, Chanel och Steelo blir lättade av att "Dra en höger" och säger "Tak så mycket".

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Biker Fox
programme.desc: Caite Upton tar plats bredvid Steelo igen medan Rob presenterar S**t Whips och Redneck Good Times. Många blir av med sina guldgruvor i De-faced. Biker Fox gästar panelen för lite spandex-humor och några rejäla skrubbsår i Biker Down.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling CXXXIV
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' möter Rob, Chanel och Steelo faror i 'Döden Down Under' och lär känna 'Lungkompisar'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling CXLI

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo och gästvärden Lolo Wood känna på hårda tag när de flyttar ut och blir 'Ömma flyttare', träffar nya kollegor i 'Dum på jobbet' och lär sig att det är okej att ge upp i 'Vi lägger av'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness dyker Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Lolo Wood rakt ner spenaten i 'Käka gräs', blir vältränade tillsammans med muskliga hundar i 'Gymhundar' och går under nollstrecket för 'Djupfryst glädje'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness skapar Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood sina egna halkfaror i 'Självsladdare', tittar förbi på gymmet för att bli 'Boxad av säck' och utmanar höjdskräcken ordentligt i 'Galna höjder'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I detta Ridiculousness träffar Rob, Steelo, Lolo Wood och Dee Snider rebeller i 'Tänker inte tåla det', bevittnar band som stretar på i 'Kommer inte slå igenom' och upplever sorgen i att spilla ut kaffet i 'Kaffetragedier'.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Dark Man
programme.desc: A grieving mother suspects her deceased son may have fallen victim to a mysterious entity called "The Dark Man."

programme.title: A Haunting: Wicked Eviction
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, a single mother of three, relocates her family for a fresh start but her dream turns to a nightmare when her family is antagonized by multiple entities. Desperate, Tammy finds a paranormal team who reveal the true evil in the home.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Tom Green
programme.desc: Comedian Tom Green returns to his hometown in Ottawa, Canada to confront a ghost.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jackee Harry, Louie Anderson, Angie Stone, Richard Burgi
programme.desc: A malicious child predator enters Jackee's home and she is rescued by her guardian angel. After a performance, Louie Anderson is visited by the ghost of his mother who had suddenly passed.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Desperate Households
programme.desc: When Julie and her family moved into their dream home in suburban New Jersey they quickly realized they were not alone.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Knickerbocker
programme.desc: PRS checks into the Knickerbocker Hotel in Linesville, Pennsylvania where the owners are reporting strange noises and the appearance of phantom children in some of the rooms.

programme.title: A Haunting: The Shadowman
programme.desc: Tim Yancey and his older brother Tom love playing in the woods surrounding their Florida home. One afternoon Tom senses a presence watching him from among the shadows. Days later, the same entity confronts Tim and chases him through the woods.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blues
programme.desc: Barney poses as a prospective rock-music recording artist to get evidence linking an organized crime figurehead played by guest star William Windom to the sudden death of a beautiful recording star who was being blackmailed by the syndicate.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Visitors
programme.desc: Guest star Steve Forrest plays the role of a millionaire publisher and communications tycoon who has sold fifty-one percent of his empire to an underworld crime syndicate which gives them a powerful influence over state politics.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nerves
programme.desc: Christopher George guest stars in the role of a psychotic ex-convict determined to wreak vengeance on society.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Run for the Money
programme.desc: Guest stars Richard Jaeckel and Herbert Edelman play gangsters who try to get control of all the illegal betting parlors in the country as well as a virtual takeover of all thoroughbred horse racing.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Connection
programme.desc: Jim Phelps and his IMF team are given the assignment of breaking an underworld ring attempting to set up one of the world's largest drug manufacturing plants off the coast of Africa.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Assassin
programme.desc: MacGyver races the clock to capture a professional killer who has accepted the job of eliminating an archbishop no matter what the circumstances.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Eraser
programme.desc: MacGyver is enjoying playing in a scrimmage with a professional hockey team when Pete Thornton recruits him to solve an international espionage case.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Human Factor
programme.desc: MacGyver is called in to test the unique security system of a top-secret research and development lab. The system, which is designed to entrap and exterminate intruders, malfunctions, trapping its creator, Jill Ludlum, and MacGyver inside.

programme.title: MacGyver: Eagles
programme.desc: In the wilderness, MacGyver and 10-year-old Darin Cooper intervene to save the lives of a pair of golden eagles injured by poachers. The poachers go after MacGyver -- witness to their crime -- and taking Darin and his mother hostage.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Wish Child
programme.desc: MacGyver fights to save a young boy from the ominous fate of a centuries-old legend.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Bianca och Morten bor i Randers med tung trafik utanför hemmet, och två små flickor som har lärt sig att öppna ytterdörren. Det fungerar inte, så de ber experterna om hjälp.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line och Kristian byggt sitt drömhus, eller det är vad de trodde. Öppna ytor och stora fönster faller dem inte längre i smaken, men vad ska de istället ha?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: För några år sedan sålde Birgitte sitt hus, och ångrade det bittert. Nu hyr hon och dottern Emma ett dyrt nybygge medan de letar efter ett hus som liknar det gamla. Kan experterna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 705
programme.desc: Pernille och Aron jobbpendlar den långa sträckan från Odense till Kalundborg varje dag. Drömmen är att bo närmare jobbet, så de kan ägna sin fritid åt något annat än att att sitta i en bil.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Fair and Perfect Knight
programme.desc: Catherine befriends a boy from the world below who leaves the tunnels to go college.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Labyrinths
programme.desc: A young man gets lost in the tunnel world and he is found by the inhabitants. They're uncertain if they should let him go because they're not sure if he can be trusted to keep their secret.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: Brothers
programme.desc: Vincent's "brother" Devin returns with Charles, a hideously deformed man seeking sanctuary.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: A Gentle Rain
programme.desc: Kanin, a resident of the Underworld, goes into a store on the surface and is recognized by a woman as the man who killed her son, years ago.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Outsiders"
programme.desc: When intruders penetrates their tunnel world, father decides to welcome them with gifts, but instead of gratitude, they are met with greed and violence. Things escalate to the point that tunnel dwellers have no other choice but to leave.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: What Are Friends For?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Aqua Vita
programme.desc: Aging women become addicted to Aqua Vita, which will keep them young forever, but at great cost.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Storyteller

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Toys of Caliban
programme.desc: An elderly couple keeps their mentally disabled son isolated because he can "bring" anything he sees in a picture.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nick of Time
programme.desc: A pair of newlyweds stopping in a small town are trapped by their own superstition when playing a fortune-telling machine in a local diner.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour
programme.desc: The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
programme.desc: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: JAG: The Colonel's Wife
programme.desc: Harm and Mac are sent to Panama to investigate the possibility that the wife of the Marine officer in charge of interdicting drugs from Columbia was smuggling drugs into the US.

programme.title: JAG: Mishap
programme.desc: "Skates", Harm's RIO when he was aboard the USS Patrick Henry, was the Landing Safety Officer in charge of the deck when a Tomcat crashes while making an emergency landing.

programme.title: JAG: Into the Breach
programme.desc: Harm and Mac agree to help guide young student "attorneys" at Iron Forge Naval Academy, a prep school for the US Naval Academy, as they conduct a mock trial.

programme.title: JAG: Boomerang (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hostilities between Harm and Brumby escalate both in and out of the courtroom and it takes Chegwidden, with Brumby's CO's approval to get them to deal with their anger

programme.title: JAG: People V. Gunny
programme.desc: Gunny is charged with gay-bashing following an off duty altercation outside a gay bar.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Burl Of My Dreams / Meet The Author/ Rhymes, Riddles And Romance
programme.desc: While the captain's daughter falls for Gopher, a book publisher flips a page in the book of love when trying to sign a burly author who happens to be accompanied by his attractive niece. Plus, an unusual couple looks for treasure.

programme.title: The Love Boat: His Girl Friday / A Wife For Wilfred/ The Girl Who Stood Still
programme.desc: Crew members become matchmakers when a man offers a handsome reward to anyone who can find him a good woman. Plus, a teen girl traveling with her mother faces potential humiliation when she runs into a former boyfriend.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Pali-Mony-O-Mine / Does Father Know Best?/ An 'A' For Gopher
programme.desc: A doctor and his lawyer girlfriend find their relationship on trial when he meets an old friend. Meanwhile, Gopher flips for his former schoolteacher, and a young man tries to impress his father when he meets two women.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Mothers Don't Do That / Marrying For Money/ Substitute Lover
programme.desc: The captain and his crew suspect that a beautiful woman is trying to kill her millionaire husband, while a glamorous divorcee (Eva Gabor) tries to get reacquainted with her son, who prefers the company of his father.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Command Performance/ Sketchy Love/ Hyde And Seek
programme.desc: A mother and daughter are shocked to see the girl's long-lost father entertaining passengers as the cruise comedian. Plus, a teenager pursues Gopher and drastically changes her appearance to try and catch his eye.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fearless Fonzarelli Part I
programme.desc: For a television show, the Fonz sets a record by jumping his motorcycle over fourteen garbage cans. He ends up crashing into Arnold's chicken stand, and while recuperating from a broken leg, upsets the regimen of the Cunningham household.

programme.title: Happy Days: Football Frolics
programme.desc: To raise money for the big football game, the boys decide to start their own babysitting service. In Football Frolics, Richie, Potsie and Ralph have their hopes set on seeing the big football game of the year, but tickets can't be found anywhere.

programme.title: Happy Days: Two Angry Men
programme.desc: When Fonzie sets a pigeon coop atop the Cunningham garage and the roof caves, Mr. Cunningham sues to collect damages. In Two Angry Men, Laverne and Shirley prevail upon Fonzie to care for a coop of pigeons.

programme.title: Happy Days: Sight for Sore Eyes
programme.desc: After reading too many foreign car manuals, Fonzie is plagued with headaches and is forced to wear glasses for a few weeks, but fears glasses aren't cool.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie Loves Pinky Part II

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.
